channel.title: Financial Regulation Hub · IRDAI
channel.description: New and amended rules from Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India, as covered by the Financial Regulation Hub.

item.title: IRDAI: Constitution of the Fund Management Committee under the IRDAI (Policyholders' Education and Protection Fund) Regulations, 2026
item.description:
IRDAI · Order · IRDAI/PP&GR/ORD/MISC/155/11/2026

Effective 2026-11-25.

Who it covers: IRDAI; administration of the Policyholders' Education and Protection Fund.

  • Sets up the committee that manages the Fund under regulation 7(2).
  • Members serve two years, extendable by two more.

Official source

item.title: IRDAI: Two study groups on transparency and accountability in health insurance claims
item.description:
IRDAI · Press release

Who it covers: Health insurers and general insurers writing health business.

  • The IAC Sub-Committee on Health Insurance has formed two study groups: one on claims and grievance metrics and standard reason codes for rejections and deductions, the other on real-time tracking of the claim journey.
  • Both are to report by 26-12-2026. No rule has changed yet.

Official source

item.title: IRDAI: Re-constitution of the Advisory Committee to review the performance of the Insurance Ombudsman system
item.description:
IRDAI · Order · IRDAI/PP&GR/ORD/MISC/154/11/2026

Effective 2026-11-23.

Who it covers: IRDAI and the Insurance Ombudsman system.

  • Re-constitutes the committee under rule 19(1) of the Insurance Ombudsman Rules, 2017 for two years.
  • It meets at least twice a year and reports every year.

Official source

item.title: IRDAI: Expert Committee to examine responses to the consultation paper on Recalibrating Economics of Insurance Distribution
item.description:
IRDAI · Order · IRDAI/INT/ORD/MISC/157/11/2026

Effective 2026-11-23.

Who it covers: Insurers and all distribution channels.

  • Sets up an expert committee to review the responses (about 2.18 lakh answers from over 13,000 respondents) to the 23-09-2026 consultation paper and recommend refinements.
  • No rule has changed yet.

Official source

item.title: IRDAI: Penalty on a standalone health insurer for claim repudiations and deductions
item.description:
IRDAI · Enforcement order (penalty) · IRDAI/E&C/ORD/MISC/153/11/2026

Effective 2026-11-20.

Who it covers: The health insurer named in the order. The rules applied are unchanged.

  • Rs 2 crore penalty under s. 102 of the Insurance Act for repudiating claims on untenable grounds and making deductions not supported by policy terms.
  • Breaches found of regulations 27(v) and 33(d) of the Health Insurance Regulations 2016 and regulation 21(3) of the TPA Regulations; warnings and directions also issued.

Official source

item.title: IRDAI: Working Groups on convergence of the Risk Based Capital framework with Ind AS
item.description:
IRDAI · Order · IRDAI/RBC/ORD/MISC/150/11/2026

Effective 2026-11-10.

Who it covers: All insurers.

  • Sets up Life and Non-Life working groups so that Ind AS financial statements become the starting point for RBC, with defined prudential adjustments.
  • No rule has changed yet.

Official source

item.title: IRDAI: Exposure Draft: IRDAI (Subsidiary Instructions and Consultative Committees) Regulations, 2026
item.description:
IRDAI · Exposure draft (for comment)

Who it covers: All regulated entities.

  • Proposes regulations under the new ss. 114B and 114C of the Insurance Act (inserted by the SBSR Act 2025) on the scope of subsidiary instructions, consultation, urgent instructions, review and withdrawal, and Consultative Committees.
  • Comments were due by 23-11-2026.

Official source

item.title: IRDAI: Master Circular on Registration, Capital Structure, Transfer of Shares and Amalgamation of Insurers, 2026
item.description:
IRDAI · Master Circular · IRDAI/F&I/CIR/MISC/142/11/2026

Effective 2026-11-02.

Who it covers: Applicants for registration and registered insurers.

  • Consolidates procedure, forms and documents under the Registration Regulations as amended on 31-07-2026.
  • Replaces the 2024 Master Circular on the same subject.

Official source

item.title: IRDAI: Four Layer Structure: Motor Insurance Policy
item.description:
IRDAI · Circular · IRDAI/NL/CIR/MISC/145/11/2026

Who it covers: General insurers selling private car and two-wheeler policies, and their distributors.

  • Uniform wordings and an option form for a four-layer motor policy: third-party liability (mandatory), occupant liability (optional), personal accident and own damage.
  • A Customer Information Sheet is mandatory. Issued after the Supreme Court's order in CA 14369/2025.

Official source

item.title: IRDAI: Consultation paper: Recalibrating Economics of Insurance Distribution
item.description:
IRDAI · Consultation paper

Who it covers: Insurers and all distribution channels.

  • Consultation on the economics of insurance distribution.
  • Responses are now being reviewed by an expert committee set up on 23-11-2026.

Official source

item.title: IRDAI: IRDAI (Third Party Administrators – Health Services) (Amendment) Regulations, 2026
item.description:
IRDAI · Amendment Regulations · F. No. IRDAI/Reg/12/226/2026

Effective 2026-07-31.

Who it covers: TPAs and health insurers that use them.

  • TPAs with a three-year certificate apply for registration under the new s. 42D within 90 days before expiry.
  • A foreign-majority TPA must keep a resident Indian citizen as Chairperson, CEO, Principal Officer or MD.

Official source

item.title: IRDAI: IRDAI (Registration, Capital Structure, Transfer of Shares and Amalgamation of Insurers) (Amendment) Regulations, 2026
item.description:
IRDAI · Amendment Regulations · F. No. IRDAI/Reg/9/223/2026

Effective 2026-07-31.

Who it covers: Applicants and registered insurers.

  • Prior approval thresholds for share transfers restated (above 5%, 10%, 25%, 50%, 75%, or becoming the largest shareholder); a fall in holding from not taking up a rights issue counts as a transfer.
  • Rs 10,000 fee for an NOC application.
  • Lock-in may be relaxed for listing, distress or reorganisation.
  • Foreign investment must follow the Foreign Investment Rules.

Official source

item.title: IRDAI: IRDAI (Policyholders' Education and Protection Fund) Regulations, 2026
item.description:
IRDAI · Regulations · F. No. IRDAI/Reg/10/224/2026

Effective 2026-07-31.

Who it covers: IRDAI; affects where penalties are credited.

  • Creates the Fund under s. 16A of the IRDA Act, fed by IRDAI contributions, grants and penalties.

Official source

item.title: IRDAI: IRDAI (Manner and Procedure for Imposing Penalties) Regulations, 2026
item.description:
IRDAI · Regulations · F. No. IRDAI/Reg/11/225/2026

Effective 2026-07-31.

Who it covers: Anyone facing IRDAI penalty proceedings: insurers, intermediaries, agents and others.

  • Sets the show cause, reply, hearing and order process.
  • At least 21 days to reply; penalty paid within 45 days.
  • Penalties go to the Policyholders' Education and Protection Fund.

Official source

item.title: IRDAI: IRDAI (Insurance Intermediaries) (Amendment) Regulations, 2026
item.description:
IRDAI · Amendment Regulations · F. No. IRDAI/Reg/8/222/2026

Effective 2026-07-31.

Who it covers: Corporate agents, brokers, IMFs, web aggregators and other intermediaries. The Agents Regulations 2016 are not amended.

  • Registration no longer has a three-year term; it continues while the annual fee is paid.
  • Existing corporate agents must apply for a fresh certificate in Form A by 31-01-2027 (late up to 31-03-2027 with Rs 750 extra).
  • Annual fee: the higher of Rs 10,000 or 1/25 of 1% of commission and other receipts, paid before 31 January.
  • Policy documents must show the seller's name and functional ID from 01-01-2027.
  • 25 hours of training every three years for the Principal Officer and Specified Persons.
  • Annual website disclosure for foreign-majority corporate agents and those earning over Rs 10 crore in commission.

Official source

item.title: IRDAI: IRDAI (Actuarial, Finance and Investment Functions of Insurers) (Second Amendment) Regulations, 2026
item.description:
IRDAI · Amendment Regulations · F. No. IRDAI/Reg/6/220/2026

Effective 2026-07-31.

Who it covers: All insurers.

  • Aligns the regulations with the SBSR Act; 'Actuarial Report and Abstract' becomes 'Actuary Report'.
  • Defines the Appointed Actuary by reference to s. 12A of the Insurance Act.

Official source

item.title: IRDAI: Submission of Self-Contained Note and documents to the Insurance Ombudsman
item.description:
IRDAI · Circular · IRDAI/PP&GR/CIR/MISC/95/07/2026

Effective 2026-07-23.

Who it covers: All insurers except reinsurers.

  • SCN within 7 days of the Ombudsman's notice; additional documents within 3 days; all in one go.
  • Late insurers face ex parte decisions.

Official source

item.title: IRDAI: Remuneration to Key Management Persons (KMPs)
item.description:
IRDAI · Circular · IRDAI/F&I/CIR/MISC/72/5/2026

Effective 2026-05-25.

Who it covers: All insurers.

  • Revises the remuneration framework for KMPs under the Corporate Governance Master Circular.

Official source

item.title: IRDAI: IRDAI Information and Cyber Security Guidelines, 2026
item.description:
IRDAI · Guidelines · IRDAI/GA&HR/CIR/MISC/51/4/2026

Effective 2026-04-06.

Who it covers: Insurers, brokers, corporate agents, web aggregators, TPAs, IMFs, repositories and the IIB.

  • Replace the 2023 guidelines.
  • Compliance expected from the current financial year.

Official source

item.title: IRDAI: IRDAI (Actuarial, Finance and Investment Functions of Insurers) (Amendment) Regulations, 2026
item.description:
IRDAI · Amendment Regulations · F. No. IRDAI/Reg/2/216/2026

Effective 2026-04-01.

Who it covers: All insurers.

  • Financial statements under Ind AS (new Schedule IIA).
  • IRDAI may allow one year's forbearance if requested by 30-04-2026 with a Board-approved action plan.

Official source

item.title: IRDAI: Transitional arrangements for annual fee and certificate of registration (intermediaries)
item.description:
IRDAI · Circular · IRDAI/INT/CIR/MISC/41/3/2026; extended by IRDAI/INT/CIR/MISC/91/7/2026

Effective 2026-02-05.

Who it covers: Brokers, corporate agents, IMFs and web aggregators.

  • Three-year renewal discontinued from 05-02-2026.
  • Interim annual fee arrangements until the amended regulations; extended on 02-07-2026 and ended when the regulations were notified on 31-07-2026.

Official source

item.title: IRDAI: Sabka Bima Sabki Raksha (Amendment of Insurance Laws) Act, 2025 comes into force
item.description:
IRDAI · Act · Act 40 of 2025

Effective 2026-02-05.

Who it covers: All insurers and intermediaries.

  • Foreign investment in Indian insurers up to 100%.
  • Intermediary registration continues subject to annual fee.
  • New s. 102: up to Rs 1 lakh a day, maximum Rs 10 crore, for failures by insurers and intermediaries.
  • New s. 105BA penalties for unregistered intermediaries and those who use them.
  • IRDAI can order disgorgement (s. 34).
  • An agent's commission on a policy for their own life, health or property is not a rebate.
  • Foreign re-insurers' Indian branches (including Lloyd's) need net owned funds of Rs 1,000 crore, down from Rs 5,000 crore (s. 6(2)).
  • Prior IRDAI approval for share transfers is needed above 5% of paid-up capital, up from 1% (s. 6A(4)(b)(iii)).
  • Not in the Act: composite licences and permission for insurers to distribute other financial products, both in the earlier draft Bill, were dropped before enactment. An Indian insurance company's 'sole purpose' remains insurance business (s. 2(7A)), and an insurer still may not carry on any business other than insurance business or prescribed business (s. 3(4)(f)); the Central Government may notify other forms of contract as insurance business (s. 2(6D)).

Official source

item.title: IRDAI: Mandatory 1600-series numbers for service and transactional calls
item.description:
IRDAI · Circular · IRDAI/PP&GR/CIR/MISC/02/01/2026

Effective 2026-02-15.

Who it covers: All insurers and insurance intermediaries.

  • Service and transactional voice calls only from 1600-series numbers after 15-02-2026.

Official source

item.title: IRDAI: IRDAI (Insurance Fraud Monitoring Framework) Guidelines, 2025
item.description:
IRDAI · Guidelines · IRDAI/IID/GDL/MISC/112/10/2025

Effective 2026-04-01.

Who it covers: All insurers, intermediaries and distribution channels.

  • Board-approved anti-fraud policy reviewed yearly; Fraud Monitoring Committee headed by a KMP.
  • Annual FMR-1 return within 30 days of year end.
  • Intermediaries keep their own anti-fraud policies and alert insurers to suspected fraud.
  • Replaces the 2013 framework.

Official source

item.title: IRDAI: Master Circular on Rural, Social Sector and Motor Third Party Obligations
item.description:
IRDAI · Master Circular · IRDAI/NL/CIR/RSS/85/07/2025

Effective 2025-07-25.

Who it covers: All insurers.

  • Restates how obligations are allocated and reported.

Official source

item.title: IRDAI: Corporate agency matters for RRBs amalgamated from 1 May 2025
item.description:
IRDAI · Circular · IRDAI/CA/CIR/MISC/64/05/2025

Effective 2025-05-09.

Who it covers: Regional Rural Banks that are corporate agents, and their partner insurers.

  • Sets the process for corporate agency registration and tie-ups after RRB amalgamation.

Official source

item.title: IRDAI: Bima-ASBA: UPI one-time mandate for premium
item.description:
IRDAI · Circular · IRDAI/PP&GR/CIR/MISC/37/02/2025

Effective 2025-03-01.

Who it covers: Life and health insurers and their distribution channels.

  • Insurers must offer a UPI mandate that blocks the premium and debits it only on acceptance.
  • Mandate valid up to 14 days or until the underwriting decision.

Official source

item.title: IRDAI: Premium revision for senior citizens in health insurance
item.description:
IRDAI · Circular · IRDAI/HLT/CIR/MISC/27/1/2025

Effective 2025-01-30.

Who it covers: General and standalone health insurers.

  • Premiums for senior citizens may not rise by more than 10% a year.
  • Prior consultation with IRDAI for larger increases or withdrawals.

Official source

item.title: IRDAI: IRDAI (Maintenance of Information by the Regulated Entities and Sharing of Information by the Authority) Regulations, 2025
item.description:
IRDAI · Regulations · F. No. IRDAI/Reg/4/211/2025

Effective 2025-01-10.

Who it covers: Insurers, intermediaries and insurance intermediaries.

  • Electronic policy and claim records held in India.
  • Records kept at least 10 years; claim files 3 to 12 years by claim size.
  • Replaces three older regulations, including the 2015 records regulations.

Official source
